challenge.en: Scaling 3D optical measurement to 12 stereo pairs (24 cameras) on an active line.
challenge.zh-TW: 將 3D 光學量測擴展至產線 12 組立體相機（24 顆相機）即時檢測。

solution.en: Designed system architecture, deterministic hardware trigger sync bus, and tuning specs.
solution.zh-TW: 主導系統架構設計、硬體觸發同步匯流排與跨部門調校規格。

boundary.en: Advanced prototype MVP to factory-ready production testing before product launch.
boundary.zh-TW: 推進成果：量測原型進入工廠上市前的產線上線測試階段。

aInput.en: Production line mechanical vibration & optical frame displacement
aInput.zh-TW: 產線輸送帶機械震動與光學相機拍攝位移

weakestLink.en: OS network polling jitter (500μs = millimeter 3D calibration blur)
weakestLink.zh-TW: OS 網路輪詢排程抖動（500μs 延遲即造成毫米級 3D 標定錯位）

bOutput.en: Deterministic sub-microsecond hardware sync; factory-ready testing
bOutput.zh-TW: 次微秒硬體同步匯流排；推進至工廠上市前的產線上線測試

strictInvariant.en: Microsecond trigger jitter across all 24 cameras must remain strictly below optical exposure shutter window to eliminate spatial blur.
strictInvariant.zh-TW: 24 顆相機的微秒級觸發抖動必須嚴格低於光學曝光快門視窗，以徹底消除運動模糊與空間錯位。

en: Replacing automated production conveyor mechanical assembly
Developing custom proprietary camera sensor silicon
zh-TW: 改造自動化產線輸送帶之機械機構
自研專用影像感測器晶片

failureConditions.en: If factory floor electromagnetic interference exceeds industrial shielding thresholds, hardware bus initiates deterministic fault assertion rather than capturing desynced frames.
failureConditions.zh-TW: 若工廠現場電磁干擾超出工業屏蔽閾值，硬體匯流排執行確定性中斷告警，杜絕非同步殘影寫入資料庫。

challenger.en: Why use a deterministic hardware trigger sync bus instead of software network time protocol (PTP/IEEE 1588)?
challenger.zh-TW: 為什麼堅持設計硬體觸發同步匯流排，而不直接用軟體網路時間協定（PTP/IEEE 1588）？

defense.en: Software network polling introduces non-deterministic OS kernel scheduling jitter (100μs–1ms) on busy line controllers. At conveyor line speed, 500μs equals millimeter-level optical displacement, ruining 3D stereo calibration. Physical hardware sync lines guarantee sub-microsecond determinism.
defense.zh-TW: 軟體網路輪詢在產線控制器高負載時會引入非確定性的 OS 排程抖動（100μs–1ms）。在輸送帶運轉速度下，500μs 的時序差就等於毫米級的光學位移，摧毀 3D 立體標定精度。實體硬體同步線提供次微秒級確定性保證。

challenger.en: What was the biggest boundary test failure before reaching factory-ready status?
challenger.zh-TW: 在達到工廠上線前測試階段前，最大的邊界測試失敗點是什麼？

defense.en: Thermal drift of camera mounting brackets altering stereo baseline extrinsic matrix after 8 continuous hours of operation. Solved by defining periodic automated validation targets and thermal compensation specs.
defense.zh-TW: 連續運轉 8 小時後，相機支架的熱脹冷縮導致立體基線外參矩陣微幅漂移。透過定義週期性自動標定靶標與熱補償調校規範解決。

staff.en: Deterministic hardware sync bus; sub-microsecond multi-camera trigger invariant
staff.zh-TW: 確定性硬體同步匯流排；次微秒級多相機觸發不變量

em.en: De-risked 24-camera automated line from prototype to factory production testing
em.zh-TW: 化解 24 顆相機產線整合風險，推進至工廠上市前的產線上線測試

recruiter.en: Hardware-software integration · 3D Computer Vision · 24 Cameras · Production Line
recruiter.zh-TW: 軟硬整合 · 3D 電腦視覺 · 24 顆相機 · 工廠自動化產線
